subject: Game Theory
title: The Payoff Matrix
description: A fast breakdown of The Payoff Matrix for builders.

hook.text: Game theorists map every possible outcome in a grid called a payoff matrix.

buildup.text: Each cell shows what both players get for every combination of choices they can make.

discovery.text: In the classic version: mutual silence gets 1 year each, mutual betrayal gets 5, a split gives 0 vs 10.

twist.text: The matrix proves betrayal dominates—it gives a better payoff no matter what the other player chooses.

climax.text: Yet mutual cooperation beats mutual betrayal. The best individual move isn't the best group move.

punchline.text: Numbers don't lie, but they can mislead.

quiz.question: What does a payoff matrix show?
